title: 第1章系统来了
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
“师姐......“

    “怎么啦，亲爱的小师弟?有什么不开心的跟师姐讲讲，让师姐开心开心啊!“

    这座略显荒凉的院子里，此时正站着两位年纪不大的男女。

    少年穿着一件黑色短打衣衫，倒是生了一副好相貌，即便放在修行界里，也算得上是顶尖的俊秀模样，只是此刻脸色微微泛白，透出几分虚弱。

    站在他对面的少女，约莫年长几岁，一身干练的武服，背后斜挎一杆红缨长枪，颇有英姿飒爽的风范。不过此时，她脸上却带着一丝戏谑的笑意，打量着眼前的少年。

    望着面前眯眼浅笑的师姐，季南北只觉得一阵无奈。

    “师姐，虽然自从入门以来，师尊就一直教导我们，身为魔道修士，凡事应当依靠自己，可是......我恐怕真的撑不住了。“

    师姐林梦夕见季南北确实面色不佳，也收敛了玩笑的神色。

    “遇到什么难题了?是修行上遇到瓶颈，还是功法运转不畅?“

    季南北深深吸了一口气，抬起眼眸望向这位算不上熟悉的师姐。配合那张无可挑剔的俊脸，这一眼足以称得上少女杀手。

    “师姐，我肚子饿......“

    林梦夕听完，整个人怔在原地。

    她设想了很多种可能，也许是修道艰难前途渺茫，也许是资源匮乏进境缓慢，这些都是修士常会遇到的困扰。可她万万没有料到，季南北会说出“肚子饿“这三个字。

    见林梦夕发愣，季南北接着说道：

    “师姐啊，我虽然已经引气入体，可终究只是个练气期的小修士......还没到能够辟谷的境界，虽然体质比凡人强上一些，但已经半个月没吃过东西了......再这样下去，真的要饿出事了!“

    林梦夕这才恍然想起，自己这位师弟和她不同，尚未筑基，无法辟谷，是需要正常进食的。

    而宗门之内，以往根本没人需要吃饭，自然就没有储备粮食。

    她们居然把这么基本的事情都给忘了，差点把新入门的师弟活活饿死。

    想到这儿，林梦夕也难免有些歉疚，连忙道：

    “师弟你在这儿等着，师姐这就下山去给你弄点吃的。“

    说罢，林梦夕身影一闪，化作一道残影消失在原地。

    什么?你问为什么是“弄“而不是“买“?

    别开玩笑了，这儿可是魔宗!

    身为魔修，当然要做尽坏事才对!

    确认自家师姐已经离开，季南北飞快回到自己屋内，取出早就收拾好的行囊，准备溜之大吉。

    这快活林魔宗他是一天也待不下去了!

    别看快活林魔宗名头听起来威风，实际上早就破败不堪。
content_en:
"Sister..."

    "What's the matter, dear little junior brother? If you're unhappy, tell me what's wrong with me, so that I can make you happy!"

    In this slightly desolate courtyard, two young men and women were standing.

    The young man was wearing a black shorts shirt, but he had a good appearance. Even in the world of spiritual practice, he could be considered top-notch handsome, but his face was slightly pale at the moment, showing a bit of weakness.

    The girl standing opposite him was about a few years older. She was dressed in a smart military uniform and had a red-tasseled spear slung across her back. She had a rather heroic demeanor. But at this time, she had a teasing smile on her face as she looked at the boy in front of her.

    Looking at the senior sister with narrowed eyes and a slight smile in front of him, Ji Nanbei felt helpless.

    "Senior sister, although our master has been teaching us since we started, as demonic monks, we should rely on ourselves in everything, but... I'm afraid I really can't hold on any longer."

    Senior sister Lin Mengxi saw that Ji Nanbei's expression was indeed bad, so she stopped her joking expression.

    "What kind of problem are you encountering? Is it a bottleneck in your practice, or is your technique not running smoothly?"

    Ji Nanbei took a deep breath and raised his eyes to look at this unfamiliar senior sister. Coupled with that impeccably handsome face, this look is enough to be called a girl killer.

    "Sister, I'm hungry..."

    After hearing this, Lin Mengxi froze on the spot.

    She imagined many possibilities. Maybe it was because of the difficulty of cultivating the path and the bleak future, or maybe because of lack of resources and slow progress. These are the troubles that monks often encounter. But she never expected that Ji Nanbei would say the words "hungry".

    Seeing Lin Mengxi in a daze, Ji Nanbei continued:

    "Senior Sister, although I have introduced Qi into my body, I am only a young monk in the Qi training period after all... I have not yet reached the stage of being able to live without grains. Although my physique is stronger than that of ordinary people, I haven't eaten for half a month... If I continue like this, I will really get hungry and have an accident!"

    Lin Mengxi suddenly remembered that her junior brother was different from her in that he had not yet established a foundation and could not live without food, so he needed to eat normally.

    Within the sect, no one needed to eat in the past, so naturally there was no food reserve.

    They actually forgot such basic things and almost starved the new junior disciple to death.

    Thinking of this, Lin Mengxi inevitably felt a little guilty and said quickly:

    "Junior brother, please wait here. Senior sister will go down the mountain to get you some food."

    After saying that, Lin Mengxi's figure flashed and disappeared into an afterimage.

    What? Why is it “get” instead of “buy”, you ask?

    Don't be kidding, this is the Demon Sect!

    As a demon cultivator, of course you have to do all the bad things!

    After confirming that his senior sister had left, Ji Nanbei quickly returned to his house, took out his bag that he had packed long ago, and prepared to run away.

    He can't stay in this Happy Forest Demon Sect for another day!

    Although the name of Happy Forest Demon Sect sounds majestic, in fact it has long been in dilapidated state.
